column1: # Game profile of Darkest Dungeon (Switch, base game 1.0.2 = v0).
# Red Hook Studios / Sickhead Games, OpenGL 4.5 through EGL, SDK 3.6.0.
# Shaders are GLSL 1.20 that the game puts together at run time from RomFS shaders/*.glsl
# and main's video shaders: captured on the Mac (gl_capture.tsv) and translated by gl_shaders.py.
# subsdk1 is NintendoSDK_OpenGL: the host's GL layer (hle_gl.m) supplies OpenGL functions directly
# main never sets a heap (its memory is its own bss): a 256 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false

column2: Darkest Dungeon has no NVN shaders (its GLSL shaders go through the GL layer)
